# LEAK

> Engine-verified chess error analysis for a Chess.com account.

## For agents

Read in order:

- [docs/llm/INDEX.md](docs/llm/INDEX.md)
- [docs/llm/SYSTEM.md](docs/llm/SYSTEM.md)
- [docs/llm/FILEMAP.md](docs/llm/FILEMAP.md)
- [docs/llm/SCHEMA.md](docs/llm/SCHEMA.md)
- [docs/llm/ROUTES.md](docs/llm/ROUTES.md)
- [docs/llm/DECISIONS.md](docs/llm/DECISIONS.md)

Then the matching domain file under `docs/llm/_*.md`.

Coding constraints live in `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`. If docs and rules disagree, code + rules win; update the vault in the same change.

## For humans

Obsidian vault: open the `docs/` folder (not the git root). Start at [docs/Home.md](docs/Home.md).
